about_the_game:
Langu City is a mysterious city nestled in the desert. Its population is small, yet prosperous and peaceful, its people

friendly and welcoming, and it has for many years been subservient to the Han Empire.However, over the past year,

the ruler of Langu City has become increasingly suspicious. He no longer appears in the imperial capital to meet

with the emperor, nor does he pay tribute on schedule.The Han Empire has dispatched ambassador after ambassador

to investigate, but none have returned.You have accepted the imperial commission to lead the fifth embassy to Langu City, vowing to uncover the truth.

Equipment

You are initially equipped with standard Han Empire infantry equipment. During your adventures, you will encounter

blacksmiths in the Western Regions and can commission them to craft more sophisticated weapons and equipment,

thereby improving your survivability.

Skill

A group of witches thrives in Langu City, mastering ancient secret arts. Maintaining good relationships with them and

learning powerful secret arts from them will significantly enhance your survivability.

short_description: For many years, the city of Langu was subject to the Han Empire, enjoying its protection. However, recently, its ruler has stopped appearing before the Emperor and has stopped paying tribute regularly. You have accepted the imperial commission to lead an embassy to Langu City, to uncover the truth.
